questions.scenario: Your mom asks you to clean your extremely messy room. What is your approach?

options.text: I just grab a broom and start cleaning aggressively.
I check exactly where the dirt is coming from first.
I rearrange my furniture to make the room look much cooler.
I promise my younger sibling ₹50 to do it for me.

questions.scenario: You open Instagram. What kind of post makes you stop scrolling and look?

options.text: A satisfying video of someone harvesting fresh giant vegetables.
A video exposing fake, unhealthy ingredients in popular snacks.
A beautiful, aesthetic video of a cozy wooden house in a forest.
A video about how a 19-year-old started a massive green-tea brand.

questions.scenario: During the lunch break at school, your friend brings a weird-looking healthy sandwich. What do you say?

options.text: 'Can I try a bite? I'll eat anything that tastes fresh.'
'What exactly is inside that? Are you sure it's fresh?'
'It looks terrible! You should have packed it better.'
'If it actually tastes good, we could totally sell these in the canteen.'

questions.scenario: You get ₹5,000 as a birthday gift. What are you most likely to buy?

options.text: A cool camping tent or outdoor sports gear.
A smartwatch that tracks my sleep, steps, and health perfectly.
Some LED lights, posters, or aesthetic decor for my room.
Some trendy, branded clothes to look sharp and confident.

questions.scenario: If someone gives you a puzzle to solve, how do you handle the frustration?

options.text: I keep trying physically, twisting and turning it until it's done.
I sit in a quiet corner and deeply study the patterns.
I get bored of the rules and just make a nice pattern with the pieces.
I look up the quickest shortcut or hack on YouTube.

questions.scenario: You are making Maggi (instant noodles), but you want to make it special. What do you do?

options.text: Chop lots of fresh veggies and throw them in.
Measure the exact amount of water and masala for the perfect taste.
Serve it in a nice bowl and garnish it perfectly to look like a restaurant dish.
Make a huge batch and charge my siblings to eat it.

questions.scenario: Your friends are planning a weekend trip. What is your role?

options.text: The one carrying the heavy bags and setting up the campfire.
The one checking Google Maps and making sure we aren't scammed.
The one picking the most beautiful, photogenic location to visit.
The one collecting the money and managing the budget.

questions.scenario: When you play a video game (like GTA or Minecraft), what do you hate doing?

options.text: Reading long instructions or tutorials.
Playing with random people who don't follow the rules.
Playing in ugly or badly designed maps.
Grinding for hours just to earn a few in-game coins.

questions.scenario: A dog or cat suddenly enters your classroom. What is your reaction?

options.text: I try to hold it, pet it, and play with it.
I check if it looks sick or if it has a collar.
I quickly take a cute picture or video of it.
I figure out how to lure it outside with some food.

questions.scenario: What is the best compliment someone can give you?

options.text: 'You are so hardworking and tough.'
'You are so smart and always notice the small details.'
'You have amazing taste and style.'
'You are a natural leader and so confident.'

Farm_Manager.title: Farm Manager / Agronomist
Farm_Manager.primary_match_text: You love action! You don't like overthinking; you just want to get your hands dirty and get the job done. You are energetic and practical.
Farm_Manager.day_in_the_life: Waking up early, checking crop health, managing the irrigation system, and bringing in the fresh harvest.
Farm_Manager.alternative_match_text: Since you are highly energetic and practical, managing the day-to-day operations of a large farm is a great alternative for you.
Farm_Manager.roadmap: Take Science (Biology) or Agriculture in 11th/12th. Pursue a B.Sc in Agriculture or Agronomy.

Quality_Inspector.title: Organic Quality Inspector / Certifier
Quality_Inspector.primary_match_text: You are the smart observer. You notice small details that everyone else misses and always want to know the truth behind things.
Quality_Inspector.day_in_the_life: Visiting farms, taking soil and water samples, testing them in a lab, and issuing official organic certification documents.
Quality_Inspector.alternative_match_text: Because you have a sharp eye for detail and hate rule-breakers, scientifically testing and certifying organic produce is a strong backup option.
Quality_Inspector.roadmap: Take Science (PCB) in 11th/12th. Pursue a B.Sc in Environmental Science, Botany, or Chemistry.

Permaculture_Designer.title: Permaculture & Eco-Farm Designer
Permaculture_Designer.primary_match_text: You have a highly creative brain. You naturally want to organize things to make them look beautiful, aesthetic, and peaceful.
Permaculture_Designer.day_in_the_life: Surveying empty land, drawing digital blueprints for water flow, selecting companion plants, and creating beautiful eco-resort layouts.
Permaculture_Designer.alternative_match_text: If you want to use your creative brain more than your physical energy, you could focus purely on designing beautiful green spaces.
Permaculture_Designer.roadmap: Any stream works, but Science or Arts with Drawing is good. Look into Architecture, Landscape Design, or Permaculture courses.

Organic_Brand_Owner.title: Organic Brand Owner / Agribusiness Entrepreneur
Organic_Brand_Owner.primary_match_text: You have a pure street-smart business mind. You know how to talk to people, manage money, and find shortcuts to get what you want.
Organic_Brand_Owner.day_in_the_life: Meeting farmers, designing premium packaging, running social media ads, and negotiating with high-end city supermarkets.
Organic_Brand_Owner.alternative_match_text: If you ever decide you want to focus on the money and leadership side of things, building a green brand is a highly profitable path.
Organic_Brand_Owner.roadmap: Take Commerce in 11th/12th. Pursue a BBA, B.Com, or B.Sc in Agribusiness Management.
